nodes.description: Private owner address slot in Ownable; governs access control for privileged functions.
Public implementation address in Upgradeable_0_8; delegatecall target of the proxy fallback.
Context._msgSender internal view returning msg.sender; base of the ownership identity check.
Modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender(); the sole access-control gate of the contract.
Public view returning the current _owner state variable.
Privileged function that sets owner to address(0) under onlyOwner.
Privileged function that changes ownership under onlyOwner with zero-address check.
Private internal writer of the _owner state variable and emitter of OwnershipTransferred.
Library helper using extcodesize to verify an address is a deployed contract.
Library function performing an ETH value transfer via low-level call to an arbitrary recipient.
Library function performing a low-level call{value} to an arbitrary target with user data.
Library function performing a staticcall to an arbitrary target.
Library function performing a delegatecall to an arbitrary target, executing foreign code in this context.
Internal helper that bubbles up revert data from low-level calls using assembly revert.
onlyOwner function that swaps the proxy implementation address after an isContract check.
Fallback function that copies calldata and delegatecalls the implementation address.
Caller-controlled origin of the transaction; compared against owner in onlyOwner.
delegatecall(gas(), impl, ...) executed in the proxy fallback with attacker-supplied calldata.
recipient.call{value: amount}("") forwards all gas to a caller-supplied address before state finalization checks.
target.call{value: value}(data) low-level value call to an arbitrary, user-supplied target.
target.staticcall(data) read-only external call to an arbitrary target.
target.delegatecall(data) executes untrusted code in the calling contract's storage context.
Address parameter of isContract checked via extcodesize.
Payable address parameter of sendValue receiving the ETH value transfer.
ETH amount parameter of sendValue forwarded to the external call.
Arbitrary destination address parameter of the call helper functions.
Calldata bytes parameter passed through to low-level calls.
Wei value parameter attached to the low-level call in functionCallWithValue.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership written into _owner.
Implementation contract address parameter of replaceImplementation.
Local holding extcodesize(account) result in isContract.
Local boolean capturing the success flag of a low-level call.
Local bytes holding raw return data of a low-level call.
Local cache of the implementation address read inside the proxy fallback.
Local caching the previous owner before _setOwner overwrites storage.

edges.reason: _msgSender returns the caller-controlled msg.sender value.
Sender address is passed into _setOwner during construction.
_setOwner writes the _owner state variable.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender (msg sender) against the stored owner.
onlyOwner consumes the owner() view result for its authorization check.
onlyOwner modifier guards renounceOwnership execution.
onlyOwner modifier guards transferOwnership execution.
onlyOwner modifier guards replaceImplementation execution.
transferOwnership delegates the ownership write to _setOwner.
newOwner parameter flows into _owner through _setOwner.
Previous owner is read from storage inside _setOwner.
oldOwner local caches _owner before it is overwritten.
impl parameter is the new implementation address being installed.
account parameter is evaluated by extcodesize in isContract.
size local holds the code-size check result inside isContract.
isContract return value gates the implementation write in replaceImplementation.
replaceImplementation writes the implementation state variable.
recipient parameter is the destination of the value transfer in sendValue.
amount parameter is forwarded as the transfer value in sendValue.
sendValue reaches the external value call that hands control to the recipient.
Caller-influenced recipient address is invoked by the low-level call.
target parameter is the call destination in functionCallWithValue.
data parameter is passed as calldata to the low-level call.
value parameter sets the wei attached to the low-level call.
functionCallWithValue performs the arbitrary low-level value call.
Attacker-controlled target is invoked by the value call.
functionStaticCall performs a staticcall on the supplied target.
target parameter is invoked by the static call.
functionDelegateCall performs a delegatecall on the supplied target.
Untrusted target is executed via delegatecall in this contract's context.
success flag of the low-level call is inspected by verifyCallResult.
returndata bytes are bubbled up by verifyCallResult.
fallback reads the implementation state variable before delegating.
implementation address is cached into the local impl variable.
Cached impl local is the delegatecall target in the fallback.
fallback forwards arbitrary calldata through delegatecall to the implementation.
implementation address controls which code the delegatecall executes.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only feeds the extcodesize contract check inside isContract.
Payable recipient parameter exists solely as the destination of sendValue's value call.
Amount parameter exists solely to size the value transfer in sendValue.
Arbitrary call target parameterizes the low-level call helper.
Calldata bytes parameter is only forwarded to the low-level call.
Wei value parameter is only attached to the low-level call.
newOwner parameter is only consumed by transferOwnership and its ownership write.
impl parameter is only used to set the implementation in replaceImplementation.
Local extcodesize result exists only within isContract.
Local success flag is immediately handed to verifyCallResult.
Local return data buffer is only read by verifyCallResult.
Cached implementation local is consumed by the fallback delegatecall.
Local old owner exists only to emit the ownership-change event in _setOwner.
